d:
Under the glow of the Federation Christmas market, Lena believes she’s walking toward a quiet, well-earned date.
Instead, a nightmare that should have died on the battlefield steps out of the crowd.

A buried past.
Proof that should never exist.
An ultimatum measured in a single hour.

To protect Shin’s future, Lena is forced to gamble everything—her rank, her pride, her body—once more.
This is not a story of betrayal born from desire, but of a woman cornered until there is no clean choice left.

On a holy night lit by festive lights, a noble colonel is dragged back into a hell she can never truly escape.
